errorClasses.preExecute: 0xFFFFFE00 (-511..-498): nonce advance + fee collection AND fresh fee-payer creation happen HERE; some state persists even on failure
errorClasses.view: -767 = TN_RUNTIME_TXN_ERR_VM_FAILED (fatal VM error, execute phase); -765 = VM_REVERT (program-explicit revert, rollback); -764 = CU_EXHAUSTED; -506 = EXPIRED

specPins.feePayerCreation: pre-execution: 'Fee payer account must exist OR BE CREATED with a valid state proof' (CREATION or EXISTING type). A fresh throwaway acting as its own fee payer with a CREATION proof is materialized at pre-exec time - before program execution - and exists afterward REGARDLESS of the execute-phase result. This explains rung-1 'exists despite VM_FAILED' WITHOUT any state-corruption claim.
specPins.persistenceRule: post-execution: 'Account state changes are committed if execution SUCCEEDED; failed executions preserve nonce advancement and fee collection ONLY.' A -767/-765 transaction therefore cannot half-write program-owned account data - per spec, reverted-create poisoning by partial writes does not exist.
specPins.correctedFaultModel: RATIFIED correction of the 2026-10-08 'poisoned account' reading: the activation tx CREATES the account correctly at pre-exec (exists:true is legitimate). The failures (-765 revert w/ user -26n on 10-06/07 -> -767 VM_FATAL on 10-08) happen INSIDE the faucet program's execution on the claim path, drifting between runs - a program/node-side regression on the claim leg for fresh accounts, matching the owner's chain-side escalation. Long-activated accounts claim fine (owner's released 1.4.1).
specPins.feeDistribution: per-block unified completion; producer live -> claimed_fees; else burned_fees to genesis null account (unspendable, owner all-zero, uncompressible). burned+claimed == collected. surfaced via slot metrics (GetSlotMetrics/StreamSlotMetrics) - BACKEND NOTE for future fee/revenue UI reads.
